metadata.description: Resource ID of the Log Analytics workspace used by the Container Apps environment.
Display name for the shared Azure Monitor Workbook.

content.json:
# AI Fraud Investigation Assistant

Operational telemetry for `fincrime-api`. Charts use structured JSON application logs from `ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL.Log_s` and show the last 30 days.

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerAppName_s == "fincrime-api"
| extend LogEntry = parse_json(Log_s)
| where tostring(LogEntry.event) == "http_request"
| summarize Requests = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Requests per hour

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerAppName_s == "fincrime-api"
| extend LogEntry = parse_json(Log_s)
| where tostring(LogEntry.event) == "http_request"
| extend StatusCode = toint(LogEntry.status_code)
| where isnotnull(StatusCode)
| summarize
    Requests = count(),
    Http5xxResponses = countif(StatusCode >= 500 and StatusCode < 600)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| extend Http5xxErrorRatePercent = round(100.0 * Http5xxResponses / Requests, 2)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: HTTP 5xx error rate per hour (%)

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerAppName_s == "fincrime-api"
| extend LogEntry = parse_json(Log_s)
| where tostring(LogEntry.event) == "http_request"
| extend DurationMs = todouble(LogEntry.duration_ms)
| where isnotnull(DurationMs)
| summarize
    P50LatencyMs = percentile(DurationMs, 50),
    P95LatencyMs = percentile(DurationMs, 95)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Request latency per hour (p50 and p95, ms)

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerAppName_s == "fincrime-api"
| extend LogEntry = parse_json(Log_s)
| where tostring(LogEntry.event) == "http_request"
| extend LlmUsage = todynamic(LogEntry.llm_usage)
| extend
    InputTokenCount = tolong(LlmUsage.input_tokens),
    OutputTokenCount = tolong(LlmUsage.output_tokens),
    EstimatedCost = todouble(LlmUsage.estimated_cost_usd)
| where isnotnull(InputTokenCount)
    or isnotnull(OutputTokenCount)
    or isnotnull(EstimatedCost)
| summarize
    InputTokens = sum(InputTokenCount),
    OutputTokens = sum(OutputTokenCount),
    EstimatedCostUsd = sum(EstimatedCost)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| extend TotalTokens = InputTokens + OutputTokens
| project TimeGenerated, InputTokens, OutputTokens, TotalTokens, EstimatedCostUsd
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: LLM tokens and estimated cost per day (USD)

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerAppName_s == "fincrime-api"
| extend LogEntry = parse_json(Log_s)
| extend Event = tostring(LogEntry.event), Message = tostring(LogEntry.message)
| where Event == "openai_policy_assessment_failed"
    or Message == "policy_assessment_failed"
| summarize Fallbacks = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Policy-assessment fallbacks per day

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerAppName_s == "fincrime-api"
| extend LogEntry = parse_json(Log_s)
| where tostring(LogEntry.event) == "openai_policy_assessment_rubric_override"
| summarize RubricOverrides = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Rubric overrides per day
